entities.summary: The International Social Security Association (ISSA) is an international organization bringing together national social security administrations and agencies. Founded in 1927, the ISSA has more than 340 member organizations in 165 countries. It has its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, in the International Labour Office (ILO).
